pr_title: AJ-1032:  Get engagement score for subscriber profile

comments.body:
> `[FromQuery] long subscriberId` 

This one should be using the idor class `CampMon.CmAPI.Authentication.ContactId`. 
Don't expose raw IDs to and from frontend.

Can you make this configurable and grab this from 
`app/CampMon.CmAPI/Endpoints/CrmLite/CrmLiteServiceSettings.cs` please. 

We would like to keep this flexible, and may adjust how many days (default to 60) in the future for performance or product reasons.
